subject: BlueNova CAIQ: dependency provenance and L3 evidence ask
messages:
From: Jenna Smith <j.smith@bluenova.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@bluenova.com
Date: 2028-04-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BlueNova CAIQ: dependency provenance and L3 evidence ask

Hi Priyom,

As part of BlueNova's upcoming vendor assessment (CSA CAIQ) we have a targeted request for "dependency provenance" (dependence chain / SBOM) and L3 evidence (runtime artifacts) to validate controls around third-party/components supply chain and runtime isolation. Our auditor has a focused lens on two areas: 1) provenance of third-party libraries and container images, and 2) evidence that ephemeral caches (KV caches, prefix caches) do not leak tenant data and are retained/rotated appropriately.

Can you share the following items or a plan for delivery within 10 business days?
- A CAIQ control crosswalk highlighting which controls are supported by provenance/SBOM evidence (format: CSV/XLSX)
- A sample SBOM for a representative model serving image (or a pointer to our required fields)
- Runtime evidence artifacts for KV/prefix cache retention policy and a sample log extract showing cache rotation/eviction
- Owner names for each artifact and an estimated delivery date

We appreciate a short mapping table first so we can scope if we need additional artifacts. If there are particular controls you expect to be redlines, call them out — helps with our audit conversation.

Thanks,
Jenna
Jenna Smith
Senior InfoSec Manager | BlueNova Systems
security@bluenova.com
(415) 555-0199
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Smith <j.smith@bluenova.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BlueNova CAIQ: dependency provenance and L3 evidence ask

Hi Jenna — thanks for the clear ask. We can support this scope. Attached is an initial crosswalk (caiq_dependency_crosswalk_v1.xlsx) that maps the CAIQ controls called out in your note to the artifacts we maintain. High level plan:

- Today (this email): crosswalk + owners identified inline in the sheet
- +3 business days: SBOM sample for a canonical serving image (thirdparty-sbom-sample.json)
- +5 business days: KV/prefix cache retention policy and a short log extract demonstrating eviction/rotation (kv_cache_retention_policy.pdf)
- +8 business days: consolidated evidence bundle and narrative to hand to your auditor

Notes / quick clarifications:
- Our SBOM includes package name + version + checksum for all layers; if you need a specific format (CycloneDX / SPDX) let us know and we'll emit that variant.
- For KV cache evidence, we can provide anonymized log slices and a redacted replay showing cache lifecycle for a synthetic trace; we will not include tenant content in any artifact.
- The crosswalk flags controls where we rely on compensating controls (e.g., network isolation + mTLS) — see tab "Compensating" in the sheet.

Kimberly (cc) will coordinate the artifact drops; Marissa will verify the narrative and redact where needed.

Deliverables will be uploaded to the shared Drive link below and I'll patch new items as attachments to this thread.

Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B1xExampleLink/caiq-evidence

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Security Program Manager | Redwood Inference

Adding a couple of operational details so we can avoid rework:

- For SBOM output format, BlueNova auditors typically accept CycloneDX v1.4. Priyom — can the SBOM export be emitted in CycloneDX by EOD Thursday? If not, we'll provide the JSON and a conversion step.
- For L3/runtime artifacts: we'll provide
  * kv_cache_retention_policy.pdf (policy + config snippets)
  * anonymized cache eviction log (sample lines)
  * snippet showing cache key namespace prefixes and how tenant scoping is enforced (redacted)
- Owner assignments in the crosswalk: I updated the sheet to add engineering owners for each artifact (Marcus Lin for SBOM generation, Diego for runtime logs, Marissa for narrative).

Marissa — can you confirm redaction guidance for the eviction logs? Jenna — will a redacted sample be sufficient for your auditor's initial review, or do they require full traces under NDA?

-Kimberly

Thanks Priyom / Kimberly — that plan and timeline work for us. Redacted eviction log samples are fine for the initial CAIQ submission; our auditor may request a more detailed trace under an NDA later, but for now the crosswalk + SBOM (CycloneDX if feasible) + policy PDF will let us close most related questions.

Please drop the artifacts to the Drive link and confirm when the SBOM is available (CycloneDX preferred). We'll aim to complete our internal review within 5 business days of the artifact delivery.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
